name: How to Compare Exterior Painting Quotes in Los Angeles County

mainEntity.name: How can I fairly compare two exterior painting quotes in Los Angeles County when one includes power washing and repairs and the other doesn’t spell them out?
mainEntity.text: How can I fairly compare two exterior painting quotes in Los Angeles County when one includes power washing and repairs and the other doesn’t spell them out?

acceptedAnswer.text: Los Angeles County homeowners often receive exterior painting quotes that look very different on paper, making it difficult to judge value. The key is to normalize scope before deciding. Start by creating a simple checklist: washing method, scraping and sanding, stucco or wood repairs, caulking, priming, number of finish coats, brand and product line, access equipment, and cleanup. Take the more detailed quote and use it as a baseline. Then send that checklist to the less detailed contractor and ask them to mark what is and is not included, and to add any extra costs for items not in their original bid. Ask both contractors to name exact products and specify coat counts (for example, one coat primer plus two finish coats). Clarify how they handle unforeseen repairs like rotten fascia or larger stucco patches: hourly, per patch, or included up to a certain amount. Once scopes are aligned, compare not just total price but labor approach, warranty length, and crew size. A low price without documented prep and repair almost always costs more over time through earlier failure. A standardized comparison puts you in control and makes your final choice more defensible.
acceptedAnswer.description: Fair comparison of exterior painting quotes requires standardizing scope: list prep, washing, repairs, products, and coat counts, then ask each contractor to confirm what is included or excluded. Aligning line items reveals which bid is truly lower and helps avoid surprises from missing prep or repair work.
